shell.noNotificationsHint: Approval and payment updates will appear here.

palette.placeholder: Type a page or an action…
palette.label: Command menu

login.heroTitle: Expense claims, from receipt to payment.
login.heroBody: Capture, approve and audit in one place. Oracle Fusion pays.
login.heroPoint2: ZATCA QR read straight from your receipt
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your Oracle HCM person number.
login.forgot: Forgot your password, or signing in for the first time?
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.devHint: Seeded demo users — one per role and scenario.
login.devUnavailable: Quick sign-in is not available. Is the API running?

reset.requestBody: Enter your person number. We'll email you a link that works once and expires in 24 hours.
reset.requestSentBody: If {{username}} has an ExpenseHub account with a work email, a link is on its way.
reset.setBody: Your new password signs you out everywhere else.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

home.subtitle: {{job}} · {{bu}} · Person no. {{number}}
home.readyBody: Your Oracle HCM and Payables set-up is complete.
home.blockedTitle: Before you can submit a claim
home.blockedBody: You can prepare expenses now, but submitting needs these fixed:
home.accessBody: What you can do in ExpenseHub. Roles are assigned per business unit.
home.claimsEmptyBody: Expenses and reports you create will show here with where they are and who holds them.

prereq.title: Prerequisites
prereq.description: Employees who cannot submit a claim yet, and why (FR-SET-02). Data comes from the nightly Oracle HCM and Payables sync.
prereq.emptyBody: No employee in this view has a missing prerequisite.

mail.title: Dev mail
mail.description: Every email ExpenseHub would send, straight from the notification outbox (D-33). No SMTP is used.
mail.emptyBody: Request a password link from the sign-in page and it appears here.
mail.select: Select an email to read it.

comingSoon.body: This screen is built in milestone {{id}}.
comingSoon.expenses: Capture expenses with receipt upload, ZATCA QR and OCR, and a live policy checklist.
comingSoon.newExpense: The expense entry screen: receipt on one side, form and live policy checks on the other.
comingSoon.reports: Group expenses into reports, submit them and follow every step.
comingSoon.status: See where each claim is, who holds it and since when.
comingSoon.approvals: Approve, reject or ask for more information, with policy flags on every row.
comingSoon.audit: Audit selected reports: verify receipts, adjust or disallow lines, release.
comingSoon.payables: Send approved reports to Oracle Fusion Payables and follow them to payment.
comingSoon.quickPays: Turn Fusion Payroll Quick Pays into Payables invoices.
comingSoon.setup: Expense types, approval and audit rules, options and role assignments.
comingSoon.integrations: Last run, errors and payloads for every Oracle Fusion interface.

list.title: Expenses
list.description: Expenses not yet on a report. Select some to group them into a report.
list.emptyBody: Add an expense — upload the receipt and ExpenseHub reads the ZATCA QR for you.
list.deleteBody: {{amount}} in total. Their receipts are removed too. This cannot be undone.
list.createTitle_one: Create a report with this expense
list.createBody: {{amount}} in total. You can review it before you submit it for approval.

entry.description: Upload the receipt first — the ZATCA QR fills in the seller, total and VAT. Policy checks update as you type.
entry.deleteBody: The expense and its receipt are removed. This cannot be undone.
entry.blocked: A policy check blocks this expense — fix the items marked ✕.
entry.conflict: This expense changed in another window. Reload to see the latest version.
entry.fixBlocks: Fix the blocked checks to save
entry.onReport: This expense is on a submitted report, so it cannot be changed. Withdraw the report to edit it.
entry.infoMode: An approver asked for more information. You can update the purpose, justification, attendees and receipt — not the amount, type or date.
entry.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.

form.enterKm: Enter the kilometres to see the amount
form.purposePlaceholder: e.g. Lunch with client to discuss the Q4 order
form.attendeesHint: Names and companies of everyone at the meal or event.
form.costCenterHint: Change it only when the expense belongs to another cost centre.
form.noTrips: You have no approved business trips in Oracle HCM.
form.quickPayHint: Link the Quick Pay this expense relates to, if any.
form.taxInvoiceHint: VAT is recoverable only from a receipt with a valid ZATCA QR.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.dropBody: A photo or PDF. ExpenseHub reads the ZATCA QR, or the text if there is no QR.
receipt.limits: JPG, PNG or PDF · up to 10 MB
receipt.readingBody: Looking for the ZATCA QR code.
receipt.wrongType: Upload a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
receipt.tooLarge: The file is too large (maximum 10 MB).
receipt.ocrNote: No valid QR, so the highlighted fields were read from the text. Check them before saving.
receipt.toastOcr: Filled from the receipt text — please check

policy.title: Policy check
policy.chooseType: Choose an expense type to see the policy checks.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Group expenses into a report, submit it for approval and follow every step.
reports.emptyBody: Select expenses on the Expenses page and choose Create report.
reports.notFound: This report could not be found, or you do not have access to it.
reports.infoHint: Reply below. You can also open a line to add a receipt or update its justification.
reports.lastLine: A report needs at least one expense
reports.addBody: Choose unreported expenses to add to this draft.
reports.notSubmitted: The approval steps appear when you submit the report.

note.BELOW_THRESHOLD: Not needed — the total is not above the CEO approval threshold.
note.SELF_APPROVAL: Sent to the claimant's line manager: nobody approves their own claim.

reports.blockedLines: Some expenses break a blocking rule
reports.question: Your question
reports.rejectBody: The claimant sees your reason and can correct the report and submit it again.
reports.requestInfoBody: The report stays with you; the claimant is emailed your question.
reports.withdrawBody: It goes back to Draft and the approver is told. You can change it and submit again.
reports.deleteBody: The report is removed and its expenses go back to your unreported list.

done.correct: Report reopened — make your changes and submit it again

decided.reject: Rejected — the claimant has been told

approvals.title: Approval inbox
approvals.description: Reports waiting for your decision, oldest first. Open one to see its lines and receipts.
approvals.emptyBody: Reports that need your approval appear here, and you get an email for each one.
approvals.flaggedNoBulk: Flagged reports must be opened and approved one by one

audit.title: Audit queue
audit.description: Approved reports selected for audit (OQ-03: the Accountant step is the audit). Verify receipts, adjust lines, then release or reject.
audit.emptyBody: Reports selected by the audit rules appear here once their approvals are done.
audit.readOnly: You can view this report, but it is not waiting for your audit.
audit.releaseBody: It becomes ready for payment with a net payable of {{amount}}. The claimant is emailed.

done.adjust: Line adjusted — the claimant has been told
done.disallow: Line disallowed — the claimant has been told
done.reject: Rejected — the claimant has been told

accounting.label: Preview — Oracle Fusion creates the accounting. Nothing is posted from ExpenseHub.
accounting.caption: Expected journal for this report
accounting.empty: Nothing to book: no approved amounts.

payables.description: Send approved reports to Oracle Fusion Payables as invoices and follow them until Fusion pays them. Payments run in Fusion.

empty.PAID: No payments in the last 90 days

payables.refreshFailed: The status sync failed — see the integration monitor.
payables.sendFailed_one: {{count}} report could not be sent — see Errors
payables.sendFailed_other: {{count}} reports could not be sent — see Errors
payables.confirmBody: {{amount}} in total. Each report becomes one Fusion invoice numbered like the report; sending again never creates a second one.
payables.noPayee: Not set up as a supplier with a bank account in Payables

quickPaysPage.description: Quick Pays from Fusion Payroll that should be reimbursed through Payables. Create an invoice, or exclude one with a reason.
quickPaysPage.emptyBody: Quick Pays arrive from Fusion Payroll every night.
quickPaysPage.confirmBody: {{amount}} in total, numbered QP-<BU>-<year>-<number>. A Quick Pay is invoiced only once.
quickPaysPage.failed_one: {{count}} Quick Pay could not be invoiced
quickPaysPage.failed_other: {{count}} Quick Pays could not be invoiced
quickPaysPage.excludeBody: It will not be invoiced through Payables. The reason is kept in the history.

devFusion.title: Fusion simulator
devFusion.description: Mock Oracle Fusion Payables (D-36): do what Payables would do to the invoices ExpenseHub created. Each action runs the invoice status sync, so ExpenseHub updates at once.
devFusion.autoAdvanceHint: Each status sync moves an open invoice one step: validated, then paid.
devFusion.failHint: Fusion answers the next invoice POST with HTTP 400, to try the Errors tab.
devFusion.failPending: Armed: the next send gets HTTP {{status}}.
devFusion.failArmed: The next invoice send will fail with HTTP 400
devFusion.empty: No invoices in mock Fusion yet
devFusion.emptyBody: Send a report from Finance → Payables, or create a Quick Pay invoice.

dashboard.noSpend: Your approved spend shows here once you submit reports.
dashboard.integrationErrors_one: {{count}} Oracle Fusion call failed in the last 24 hours
dashboard.integrationErrors_other: {{count}} Oracle Fusion calls failed in the last 24 hours

claimStatus.title: Where is my claim?
claimStatus.description: Every report on its way: the step it is at, who holds it and since when.
claimStatus.emptyBody: Submitted reports appear here until they are paid.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: Policy, approval and payment settings. Every change is recorded in the setup history (FR-SET-05).
setup.placeholderHint: Placeholder values until Finance confirms the list (OQ-32).
setup.conflict: Someone else changed this. Reload to see the latest values.

expenseTypes.drawerBody: Policy fields apply to new expenses; submitted reports keep the rules they were checked against.
expenseTypes.codeHint: Capitals, digits and _. Cannot change later.
expenseTypes.name: Name
expenseTypes.limitActionHint: The limit applies to each line of this type, for every grade (D-45).

chainHints.STANDARD: Every claim, unless the claimant is the CEO (D-49).
chainHints.CEO_CLAIMANT: Used when the claimant holds the CEO role (D-37).

approvalRules.drawerBody: Changes apply to reports submitted from now on; chains already running stay as they are.
approvalRules.hierarchy: Line-manager hierarchy, up to the top
approvalRules.totalGt: Only when the report total is above
approvalRules.conditionAmountHint: Leave empty to use the CEO threshold option (FR-APR-02).
approvalRules.selfApproval: If the approver is the claimant, the step goes to the claimant's HCM supervisor (D-34).

auditRules.description: After approval, a report is audited in full when any active rule matches (FR-AUD-01, OQ-33).

texts.ANY_WARNING: A line has a warn-level policy violation.
texts.MISSING_RECEIPT: A line needs a receipt and has none.
texts.TOTAL_GT: The report total is above this amount (SAR).
texts.RANDOM_PCT: This percentage of reports, chosen the same way on every re-run.
texts.DUPLICATE: Same employee, merchant, amount and date, or the same receipt image (FR-CAP-10).

options.description: System-wide values. Account combinations are set per business unit.
options.jsonHint: A list of names, e.g. ["Business Trip"]

rolesPage.description: Who holds each approval and Finance role, per business unit (FR-SET-04, OQ-02).
rolesPage.assignBody: The role applies from the start date. You cannot change your own roles.
rolesPage.searchEmployee: Search by name or person number
rolesPage.endConfirm: End {{name}}'s {{role}} role? It stops applying today.

history.description: Every setup change: who, when, old → new (FR-SET-05). The history cannot be edited.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Oracle Fusion interfaces: nightly syncs in, invoices out. Every call is logged (INTEGRATION §2).
integrations.logAdminOnly: The call log is visible to system administrators.

errors.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
errors.forbiddenBody: Ask your system administrator if you need it.

status.title: Platform health
status.subtitle: Live view of the ExpenseHub API and its connections. Refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.
status.unreachableHint: Start it with npm run dev; this page reconnects automatically.

data.memoryDetail: Saved to a local JSON file until ADW is connected

notify.label: Notifications
notify.outboxDetail: Messages show on the dev Mail page

env.devDetail: Demo data only — not for real claims

release.detail: Milestone M2 · Sign-in and app shell
